content.user_title: Audit Landing Pages for Conversion Friction
content.value_statement: Competing actions and complex forms can reduce landing page conversions. This guide helps your AI review HTML and CSS and prioritize technical improvements.
actual_capabilities: Guide an AI review of primary CTA prominence and competing actions in supplied HTML and CSS.
Identify hero section outbound links and potentially distracting popups.
Review form field counts and barriers to contacting the business.
Check structural evidence for visible headlines, trust elements, and relevant business identifiers.
Review markup and styles for potential mobile overflow, tap-target issues, and page weight hazards.
Organize observed conversion blockers into severity-ranked findings with technical recommendations.
limitations: This folder contains only the public guide, not the advertised scripts, extension source, templates, or executable checklist engine.
The review covers HTML and CSS structure, not copywriting quality or content rendered exclusively through client-side JavaScript.
URL retrieval and visual inspection depend on the host agent's available tools; the skill supplies no browser or fetch implementation.
Recommendations do not establish conversion uplift, measured performance, legal compliance, or the authenticity of trust claims.

use_cases.title: Review Campaign Readiness
use_cases.description: Identify competing hero actions, long forms, and missing trust elements before directing paid traffic to a landing page.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Frontend Fixes
use_cases.description: Review landing page HTML and CSS for structural friction and turn findings into a severity-ranked implementation list.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Audit Reports
use_cases.description: Create a consistent technical review of client landing pages while separating observed issues from assumptions requiring browser verification.

prompt_templates.title: Run a First Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this landing page HTML for conversion friction: [HTML]. Rank observed issues by severity and suggest a technical fix for each.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of supplied page markup.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Hero Actions
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the supplied hero HTML and CSS: [content]. Check primary CTA prominence, competing actions, outbound links, and headline visibility. State any uncertainty.
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of the first viewport.

prompt_templates.title: Review Form and Mobile Friction
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [HTML and CSS] for form friction, contact barriers, tap-target issues, and overflow risks. Cite structural evidence and identify checks requiring browser verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate technical review across forms and responsive styles.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Campaign Audit Backlog
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [HTML and CSS] for a campaign targeting [audience] with [primary action]. Group findings by conversion family and severity. Include evidence, fixes, and validation steps. Separate observed issues from hypotheses; do not claim measured uplift.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review that produces an evidence-based implementation backlog.

output_examples.input: Review supplied hero markup containing a signup button and three social links for a signup-focused campaign.
output: Finding: Three social links introduce competing destinations beside the primary signup action.
Priority: High for a signup-focused campaign; the conversion impact remains unmeasured.
Recommendation: Move social links below the hero and retain a prominent primary CTA.
Validation: Inspect desktop and mobile layouts, then test the revised page against the current version.

output_examples.input: Audit a signup form containing 12 required fields, including information not needed to create an account.
output: Finding: Twelve required fields create potential signup friction.
Priority: High; confirm which fields are necessary before removing them.
Recommendation: Keep essential account fields and collect optional profile details after signup.
Validation: Check validation rules and compare completion rates after an approved experiment.

best_practices: Provide the relevant HTML and CSS, target audience, campaign goal, and primary conversion action.
Require evidence for every finding and distinguish structural observations from visual assumptions or measured results.
Verify recommendations in desktop and mobile browsers, then measure conversion changes through controlled testing.
anti_patterns: Expecting the public guide to run an automated scanner or install scripts absent from the package.
Treating severity labels as proof of conversion losses, guaranteed revenue gains, or legal noncompliance.
Submitting only a URL when the host agent cannot retrieve pages, or expecting static markup to reveal client-rendered content.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It guides reviews of CTA prominence, trust elements, headline visibility, form friction, mobile structure, page weight hazards, and distracting links.

faq.question: Does the package include an automated audit engine?
faq.answer: No. The supplied folder contains only SKILL.md. Its notice states that scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.

faq.question: Can I provide a landing page URL?
faq.answer: Yes, if your host agent can retrieve it. Otherwise, provide the relevant HTML and CSS directly.

faq.question: Can it review JavaScript-rendered content or copywriting?
faq.answer: The guide excludes content rendered exclusively through client-side JavaScript and does not evaluate copywriting quality.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this guide?
faq.answer: The guide can be used with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. File access, browsing, and visual inspection depend on the host environment.

faq.question: Will the audit guarantee higher conversions or legal compliance?
faq.answer: No. Findings are recommendations, not measured outcomes or legal advice. Validate changes through browser checks, experiments, and appropriate professional review.
